source: Claude, d'après l'arbre du dépôt et le README
explication_en: The Vue webapp displays the map of license plate readers via Map.vue and calls the Fastify API through apiService.ts. The API queries Nominatim and GitHub, while Terraform deploys the counting Lambda functions.
